title: Pretraining Transformers with Quantized Softmax in Attention
abstract: arXiv:2609.33591v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-precision Transformer systems increasingly quantize attention matrix multiplications, while softmax often remains at higher precision. During pretraining, an approximate softmax changes the gradients that train the model as well as its forward computation. We study this interaction with K-interval attention, which approximates the exponential using K+1 grid values. We vary per-row grid calibration, interpolation versus hard rounding, and the placement of a straight-through surrogate relative to normalization. We derive the corresponding backward rules, including calibration derivatives, and compare these choices in pretraining experiments matched on model, data, and optimizer. Detaching the row extrema leaves the forward computation unchanged but produces a delayed increase in validation loss. translated_title: 在注意力机制中使用量化Softmax预训练Transformer
translated_abstract: 低精度Transformer系统越来越多地对注意力矩阵乘法进行量化，而softmax通常仍保持较高的计算精度。在预训练期间，近似的softmax会改变用于训练模型的梯度以及模型的前向计算。我们通过K区间注意力来研究这种相互作用，该方法使用K+1个网格值来近似指数函数。我们改变了逐行网格校准方式、插值与硬舍入的对比，以及直通替代梯度相对于归一化的位置。我们推导了相应的反向传播规则，包括校准导数，并在模型、数据和优化器完全匹配的预训练实验中比较了这些设计选择。将行极值分离（detach）会使前向计算保持不变，但会导致验证损失出现延迟性上升。在K=4的硬舍入设置下，最小-最大校准和预归一化替代方案会产生较大的损失差距；改变其中任何一个选择都会显著（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出K区间注意力方法对注意力中的softmax进行量化近似，系统研究了网格校准、舍入方式和直通替代梯度位置等设计选择对Transformer预训练的影响，并推导了相应的反向传播规则。
